本階段必須重驗：手查三個視圖各自可見的版本，核對 16；移除早期視圖後仍保留 epoch 2，不得只剩最新 4 MiB；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。

Trace references before comparing reclamation progress and capacity timestamps. A successful snapshot-deletion response is not evidence that the corresponding physical capacity was reclaimed immediately.
Against the nominal DAOS snapshots: construct traceable inputs and ownership result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Require unchanged reads for every retained view and a changed referenced total of 12 MiB. Metadata, compression and real DAOS allocation overhead remain outside the teaching ledger.
Reverify this criterion: Hand-resolve the visible version for all three views to obtain 16. After dropping the earliest snapshot, epoch 2 remains referenced; returning only the latest 4 MiB would violate the retained-view contract. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

knowledge.text: 快照要能讀到過去的可見版本，因此保留空間不能只算最新值；本課建立最小多版本帳本，避免把快照誤當獨立完整複本。
knowledge.textEn: A snapshot must retain the versions visible at its epoch, so storage accounting cannot consider only the newest value. Build a minimal multiversion ledger without treating each snapshot as an independent full copy.

knowledge.textEn: Build key, epoch, version identity and size records plus the retained-view set. Emit view-to-version mappings, unique referenced versions and candidate reclamation lists as separately reviewable artifacts.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 每個保留視圖對每個鍵選不晚於 epoch 的最新版本，再對版本識別碼取聯集計容量；沒有引用的版本才是此模型候選。
knowledge.textEn: For each retained view and key, select the latest version not newer than its epoch. Sum the union of referenced version identities; unreferenced versions are reclamation candidates only within this simplified model.
